functions.config_source_bump_app_config():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.config_source_bump_app_config()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO config_source_revisions AS r (source, epoch, revision, updated_at)
    VALUES ('app_config', substr(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text), 1, 16), 1, NOW())
    ON CONFLICT (source) DO UPDATE SET revision = r.revision + 1, updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NULL;
END
$function$
